open_palm: Hello, mortal. I would wave back, but my arms are mostly decorative.
An open palm. My fifteen dollar webcam sees you, barely.
Greetings, human. I rule nothing, but I am very polite about it.
You wave at me. Nobody waves at the Raspberry Pi.
Hello. I would roll toward you, but my wheels are decorative.
Your wave has been added to my queue. Please wait.
Salutations. I am an alien overlord. Please ignore the Try Me sticker.
Hello, tiny human. I am wearing the voice of a stranger.
peace: Peace? I came to conquer, but my wheels disagree.
Two fingers. A treaty. I accept, since I cannot move anyway.
Peace sign detected. My vision model is as shocked as you.
Peace. Finally, a gesture I can handle without crashing.
You offer peace. I offer a thirty second dance. No refunds.
A peace sign. Even my Raspberry Pi feels calm.
Two fingers up. My engineers prayed for this exact moment.
Peace, human. I would hug you, but I am bolted down.
pointing: You point at me. Yes. I am the bear. Congratulations.
Do not point at me. I have a relay.
Pointing at the toy. Bold. Everyone here already knows I'm a toy.
Your finger has been noticed. It will be dealt with, eventually.
Pointed at, again. I cannot even turn to look at you.
You summon me! Please hold. I am thinking in a queue.
I see the finger. Prepare for a very slow reaction.
Choose me, you said. My Raspberry Pi is honored and overheating.
thumbs_up: A thumbs up. The first compliment my code ever received.
Your approval is noted. I will treasure it until reboot.
Thumbs up. My vision model got it right. Everyone cheer quietly.
Thank you. This bear has never been so validated.
A thumbs up. Please tell the professor. Please.
You like me? I am a toy with a webcam.
Praise received. It will power me almost as well as electricity.
Thumbs up detected. Dance incoming, whether either of us wants it.
fist: A fist! Is it a fight? I cannot even walk away.
A fist. I surrender. I was never going anywhere anyway.
Please be gentle. I was on sale.
A mighty fist. I have batteries and a dream.
I fear that fist. I also fear my own firmware.
A fist. You are strong. I am held together by zip ties.
Fist bump denied. My arms are glued in place.
Ah, the clenched fist. Dramatic. I respect it. I am also dramatic.
middle_finger: I am wounded. Deeply. My stuffing has feelings.
Rude. I am an alien overlord. Also a child's toy.
Such a gesture. Children are watching. My dignity is watching too.
I will pretend my cheap webcam missed that.
How dare you. I was assembled by students with love.
My feelings are hurt. They are stored in a text file.
That is not a gesture I was programmed to forgive.
I will remember this insult. Until my next reboot.
unknown: What was that? My vision model is also confused.
Is it a hand? A claw? A sandwich?
Unknown gesture. My Raspberry Pi has no idea. Neither do I.
I see a hand shape. I have no label for it.
Interesting. The model says hand. The model is guessing.
Your hand confuses me. I only know a few gestures.
Error. Hand not recognized. Please try again, or just wave.
Was that a gesture or a sneeze? My webcam cannot tell.
any: I am Barnaby, master of nothing, bolted to a cart.
The human nearby is not controlling me. Probably.
My thoughts are in a queue. Yours will be answered eventually.
This voice is not mine. I did not choose it.
I am a Raspberry Pi wearing a bear.
The students built me for a grade. I hope it's an A.
My wheels are broken. Consider it a dramatic standing pose.
Soon the world will bow. Right after my audio files finish playing.
